articles.title: Microsoft Copilot reveals secret input that allowed it to be hacked
articles.content: Secret parameter allowed hackers to steal passwords when a target clicked on a link.

articles.contentZh: 秘密参数允许黑客在目标点击链接时窃取密码。

articles.title: Vulnerability giving attackers full control of Macs is under active exploitation
articles.content: Screen-sharing bug lets remote hackers log in without a password.
